newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end up 4.7 pct on bullish trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end up 4.7 pct on bullish trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share market maintained its strong upward momentum on Tuesday, with the B index rising 7.42 points, or 4.70 percent, to end at 165.10.

The index hit an intra-day high of 168.26 and a low of 154.01 on turnover of HK$659.39 million, compared with Monday's HK$565.48 million. Of 43 Shenzhen-listed B stocks, 38 gained, one held steady and four lost.
Heavy profit-taking emerged in the early afternoon, which drove the index to its intra-day low before strong buying pushed it up all the way to the close, brokers said.
B shares have surged in recent weeks on speculation the Chinese authorities were planning market support measures.
"The bull run may extend into later this week with the inflow of fresh money continuing," one broker said.
The surge in B share prices is attracting more and more investors into the hard currency market, one analyst said.
Colour television tube maker SEG, the best performer, soared HK$0.70, or 13.73 percent, to HK$5.80 on active trade of 4.80 million shares.
China Bicycle surged HK$0.49, or 13.03 percent, to HK$4.25 on volume of 7.81 million shares.
Changan Automobile, the most active counter, rose HK$0.19 to HK$4.99 after 14.76 million shares were traded on institutional demand, brokers said.
Hotelier Dadonghai climbed HK$0.24 to HK$4.40, with 8.29 million shares changing hands. Profit-taking sent China Marine down HK$0.08 to HK$8.56 on volume of 566,900 shares.
The A market saw a strong technical rebound, with the A index rising 16.25 points, or 3.68 percent, to close at 458.32.
Turnover reached 8.99 billion yuan, compared with 8.21 billion yuan the previous session. The composite index put on 15.60 points, or 3.73 percent, to 434.15.
Packaging materials producer Zhuhai Zhongfu Stock Enterprise Co Ltd, which listed 28.875 million A shares in Shenzhen on Tuesday, ended the session at 28.85 yuan.
Property issue Jiuzhou advanced 3.02 yuan, or 16.15 percent, to 21.72 yuan.
